toolDefinitions.name: search
toolDefinitions.description: Search the public model library of Ollama. Returns the model name, its downloads, its last update and its capability and size tags. With the variants argument it lists the tags of one model with their size and context window instead. Used by the model search of the host.

q.description: Search text. Empty lists the library.

sort.description: Sort of the host: downloads, updated and latest are served, any other value is ignored.

format.description: File format of the host. The library holds models in its own format, so it is ignored.

variants.description: Name of one library model. When set, the answer lists the tags of that model and the other arguments are ignored.

filters.description: Values of the filters of this source, by filter ID.

filters.label: Tools
filters.help: Only models that can call tools.

filters.label: Thinking
filters.help: Only models that reason before they answer.
